title: phegopteris macrophylla
intro: Phegopteris macrophylla, commonly known as the Large-leaved Brake, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Phegopteris macrophylla include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in traditional remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
